allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Dear Sir/Madam,Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that we have received approval from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited for the listing and trading of 5,93,750 Equity Shares of face value Re. 1/- each, allotted under the Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).The details of the securities approved for listing and trading are as follows:  Number of Equity Shares: 5,93,750  Distinctive Numbers: 132968456 to 133562205  Date of Listing & Trading: March 19, 2025
